To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the molecular understanding of the process of DNA transfer in Agrobacterium led to the development and implementation of transgene technology and that the application of this technology in plant biotechnology has the potential to contribute to the improvement of food production systems in less developed countries.

the molecular mechanism by which the phytopathogen Agrobacterium transfers DNA to plants was elucidated and that this knowledge led to the development, by plant genetic engineering, of a number of useful plant products, which were commercialized.
the discovery of Agrobacterium-mediated DNA transfer to host plants was a major breakthrough in molecular biology and that it led to the development and application of plant biotechnology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of plant genetic modification techniques for the production of transgenic plants.

the development and use of plant transformation systems, the study of the genetic and biochemical mechanisms involved in plant development and plant-microbe interactions, and the application of plant transformation technology for plant biotechnology.
the development of novel technologies for the genetic improvement of crop plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the development of the first genetically modified plants has been a success story.
the development and use of plant biotechnology has been a major success story in the last 40 years.
plant biotechnology has been and is a success story, but that it is still a long way to go before the promises of this technology can be fully realized.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
plant biotechnology is a technology that is not only essential for fundamental research, but also for the development of crops with improved traits.

we have contributed to a better understanding of plant development and the molecular mechanisms underlying gene transfer in Agrobacterium, which led to the development and implementation of plant transgene and genome editing technologies.
plant transgenesis is an indispensable tool for fundamental plant research, for plant improvement and for the production of plant-based products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
plant biotechnology has the potential to make an essential contribution to sustainable agricultural systems and to food security, in particular for the less developed countries.
the development of transgenic plants was a major step forward in plant research.
plant biotechnology has a great deal of potential for the benefit of society.
